assets.subject: full-height wall segment of dressed stone
assets.detail: Coursed, dressed blue-gray stone blocks with thin mortar lines, gently worn. ONE single straight wall section standing upright, about 5 ft wide x 9 ft tall x 1 ft thick, seen from the front at a slight three-quarter angle. Nothing else: NO floor, NO ground, NO base slab or platform under it, NO roof, NO corner return, NO furniture or decorations attached. Both side edges are clean vertical cuts so identical pieces butt together into a longer wall. The front face is the room-facing side.
